issue_title: Memory filesystem accepts a file as an existing directory
issue_text: MemoryFileSystem.makedirs can return successfully with exist_ok=True even when the target path is an existing file. Reproduce by storing bytes at a path and then asking makedirs to ensure that same path is a directory. It should raise FileExistsError and leave the file unchanged.
success_criteria: An existing file cannot satisfy makedirs, while existing directory behavior remains valid.
